Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade one
Subject: General
Strand: Strand 14
Topic 14.3: Language Use 14.3.1 Adverbs of Place
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Language Use 14.3.1 Adverbs of Place, part of Strand 14 in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade one General.

Key inquiry question: Where do you find different things in the classroom? 2. Why is it important to place things in the right place?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Language Use 14.3.1 Adverbs of Place together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

Learning to Learn: The learner learns independently as they practise using adverbs of place in sentences to complete the task in time.
